In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover two stories shaping Indian and global markets:
1. What Separated India’s Cement Giants?
India’s cement sector saw healthy demand in Q1 FY27, but UltraTech, Ambuja Cements and Shree Cement delivered very different results. The story looks at how pricing, sales mix, fuel costs and the West Asia conflict affected their performance—and why UltraTech came out ahead despite similar industry conditions.
